title: Chapter 453 - 453 Return; Entry!
content:
Chapter 453 - 453 Return; Entry!

Chapter 453 - 453 Return; Entry!

453 Return; Entry!

Qin Yuxuan knew that Lin Fan was very capable. He had several supercars and could easily take out hundreds of millions of yuan to help her start her company.

He could even buy the entire Global Financial Building.

However, she never expected that the patriarchs of the four great families of Modu would be so polite to her because of Lin Fan. They even did not hesitate to call themselves subordinates.

As for Lin Fan, he was not too bothered by the words of the four family heads.

He just casually chatted with Ye Xiu.

From Ye Xiu, Lin Fan learned that the world’s largest oil field, a quarter of Silicon Valley, and hundreds of listed companies in the US stock market all belonged to the Qing Hong Sect.

Lin Fan did not have much of a reaction to all of this.

To him, companies and funds… were just a string of numbers.

However, Qin Yuxuan, who was sitting at the side, was completely dumbfounded.

…

At this moment, in Jingbei.

The extremely dignified man picked up the phone on the table and pressed the answer button.

“Leader, Elder Ye has already arrived in Modu, but he said that he has something important to do and doesn’t want us to follow him. Also, his physical condition doesn’t seem to be good.

“Also, Elder Ye is very concerned about a Mr. Lin. He seems to have come to Modu this time to pay a visit to Mr. Lin.”

Mr. Lin?

The dignified man frowned.

At this moment, an email popped up on the computer screen in front of the dignified man.

It was Lin Fan!

Seeing this…

The dignified man was stunned.

“Alright, I understand.”

After saying that, he hung up the phone.

Only the man in the white shirt sitting in the Audi was left. He held his phone and was at a loss.

That was it?

Elder Ye’s identity was very special, no?

‘Didn’t you ask me to take good care of and protect Elder Ye?’

He was not in good health and wanted to meet a mysterious Mr. Lin.

What did the dignified man know?

What should the man in the white shirt do now?

…

Lin Fan did not care about any of this.

After listening to Ye Xiu talk about the Qing Hong Sect for a while, he boarded a luxurious private jet to Jiangbei.

He was still a professor at Jiangbei University. It would not be good to let his students study by themselves.

Tonight, he was alone, lying comfortably on the big bed in the Coiling Dragon Villa. He slept very comfortably.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

“Today, I caught another big bug!”

“I caught two!”

Following the sound of two sparrows chirping outside the window, Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes.

Out of habit, he glanced at his phone. A text message had already appeared on the screen.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 36,989,010 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Then, Lin Fan muttered, “Let’s see what the sign-in reward is today.”

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received ten million yuan.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan chose to ignore it.

After breakfast, he drove the Cullinan straight to Jiangbei University.

Although it was not time for class yet, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Hao Zhiwu, Liu Qianqian, and Jiang Chaoqun had already arrived at the office early and were studying very seriously.

Lil White, who was lying on Hao Zhiwu’s shoulder, was the first to notice Lin Fan and let out a crisp meow.

“Master, you’re here!”

Then, Lil White jumped down from Hao Zhiwu’s shoulder and rubbed against Lin Fan’s feet.

Lin Fan stroked the cat, Lil White, a few times.

Then, he tore open a bag of premium beef cat food.

Lil White buried its head into the premium beef cat food and ate happily.

In the beginning, when Hao Zhiwu saw Lil White like this, he was so angry that his teeth hurt.

Now, he was completely used to it.

He hurriedly stopped the ballpoint pen in his hand and excitedly came in front of Lin Fan. “Professor Lin, have you told Chairman Ran? Will I be able to go to the closed beta base tomorrow?”

No wonder he was so excited.

According to the news released by Dahua Group, tomorrow was the closed beta.

The day before yesterday, Dahua Group had already announced the closed beta list.

However, Hao Zhiwu realized that his name was not on it, which made him anxious.

After all, this was the gaming helmet experience that he had always dreamed of!

Lin Fan was stunned for a moment before saying, “Oh, you mean the gaming helmet? Alright, I’ll tell Ran Fei now.”

Hao Zhiwu froze.

What Professor Lin meant was… he had not called Ran Fei yet?

His name had not been added yet?

Lin Fan did not pay much attention to Hao Zhiwu, who was frozen. He took out his phone and dialed Ran Fei’s number.

During this period of time, there was the carbon-based chip and the gaming helmet…

It could be said that Ran Fei, the chairman, was very busy.

However, when he saw that it was Lin Fan, he immediately answered the call.

“Mr. Lin, what instructions do you have?” Ran Fei asked.

Instructions?

Ran Fei was half-joking and half-serious.

Lin Fan was now the biggest shareholder of Dahua Group.

At the same time, he became the soul of Dahua Group.

Many employees of Dahua Group idolized Lin Fan!

Lin Fan smiled and said, “I don’t have any instructions. I have a student who wants to participate in the closed beta testing of the gaming helmet tomorrow. Are there any slots left?”

Ran Fei thought for a moment and said, “We’ve publicly recruited 100 beta players worldwide. However, our Dahua Group has also arranged for dozens of employees to experience it. Professor Lin, you can let your student participate in the closed beta as one of the dozens of employees.”

“Alright, that’s settled then.” Lin Fan nodded.

When Hao Zhiwu found out about this, he was so excited that he wanted to give Lin Fan a big hug.

However, Lin Fan quickly dodged to the side and said, “My sexual orientation is normal!”

At this moment, Xia Bing and Xia Xue each took a bottle of energy drink and came in front of Lin Fan.

Lin Fan casually took them and drank a mouthful of each of the two bottles.

Seeing this…

Xia Bing and Xia Xue looked like they had drunk honey, and their faces were filled with sweetness.

If it were in the past, Liu Qianqian would inevitably sigh upon seeing this scene and feel that it was not worth it for Xia Bing and Xia Xue.

At this moment, however, the image of Lin Fan standing outside the basketball court and casually throwing the basketball into the basket appeared in her mind. She could not help but reveal a look of admiration.

However, Liu Qianqian shook her head hard and said to herself, “Professor Lin already has a girlfriend, Professor Lin already has a girlfriend. Professor Lin already has a girlfriend!

“Professor Lin is a scumbag! Professor Lin is a scumbag! Professor Lin is a scumbag!”

Instantly, Liu Qianqian looked at Lin Fan with a calm gaze.
